question_text: Compare the average head_count at KeynoteHall_Stage between the morning keynote window 09:00-10:00 UTC and the afternoon keynote window 14:00-15:00 UTC on 2025-12-08. Which keynote had higher attendance and what were the approximate average head_counts?
answer_text: The morning keynote had higher attendance: KeynoteHall_Stage (hour_utc 2025-12-08T09:00:00Z–2025-12-08T10:00:00Z) averaged 450.2 head_count, while the afternoon keynote (KeynoteHall_Stage, hour_utc 2025-12-08T14:00:00Z–2025-12-08T15:00:00Z) averaged 399.5.

citations.cypher:
CALL {
  MATCH (ch:CrowdHour {camera_location: 'KeynoteHall_Stage'})
  WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T09:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-08T10:00:00Z'
  RETURN 'morning_09-10' AS window, sum(ch.avg_hc * ch.event_count) AS weighted_sum, sum(ch.event_count) AS total_samples
  UNION ALL
  MATCH (ch:CrowdHour {camera_location: 'KeynoteHall_Stage'})
  WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T14:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-08T15:00:00Z'
  RETURN 'afternoon_14-15' AS window, sum(ch.avg_hc * ch.event_count) AS weighted_sum, sum(ch.event_count) AS total_samples
}
WITH window, CASE WHEN total_samples > 0 THEN toFloat(weighted_sum)/total_samples ELSE NULL END AS avg_head_count
WITH collect({window:window, avg:avg_head_count}) AS rows
WITH rows, [r IN rows | r.avg] AS avgs
WITH rows, reduce(maxv = -1.0, x IN avgs | CASE WHEN x IS NULL THEN maxv ELSE CASE WHEN x > maxv THEN x ELSE maxv END END) AS max_avg
UNWIND rows AS r
RETURN r.window AS window, CASE WHEN r.avg IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE round(r.avg*10.0)/10.0 END AS avg_head_count, CASE WHEN r.avg = max_avg THEN true ELSE false END AS is_highest
ORDER BY window
